mostWorthwhile.text: Mineralizing the collagen framework was most worthwhile: the planned inset clearly connects collagen with toughness and mineral with resistance to compression.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the supplied cells to the framework repeated the nutrient-channel detail already shown with the blood supply, although it completed the living-bone construction.

surprise.text: The lineage picture showed matrix-producing osteoblasts becoming embedded osteocytes, and the blood-supply picture distinguished nutrient-filled channels from the larger vessel containing blood cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though combining bone cells with blood vessels before the mineralized framework felt like an abstract construction step rather than a clear developmental sequence.

continue.text: I would continue: connecting material properties and living bone to a working joint was interesting, though the later assembly choices were predictable and mostly the only available combinations.
